'''2000 Coruscant Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Coruscant region (New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00coruscant">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=coruscant 2000 Regionals: Coruscant], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010726144234/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=coruscant Internet Archive]</ref>

[[John Lolli]] of Lawrenceville, New Jersey and [[Patrick Ziagos]] of Factoryville, Pennsylvania were co-champions, and both qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Date:''' 17 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, New Jersey
